title: diff-scoped-review findings input
description: Input for finding_scope_gate.py. Each finding must anchor to the diff: file+line, or scope 'pr-level', or file+line+caused_by when the line sits outside the diff.

pr.description: Optional label, e.g. owner/repo#123 or a branch name. Not used by the gate.

id.description: Short label (F1, F2...) so the report can be discussed without quoting the claim.

file.description: Path exactly as it appears in the diff (new-side path). Omit only when scope is 'pr-level'.

line.description: Line number. On the new side unless 'side' says otherwise.

side.description: 'old' when the finding is about a removed line (deleted validation, deleted test case).

severity.description: BLOCKER/MAJOR block the PR when in scope. MINOR/NIT never block. Severity describes the bug; scope decides which PR pays for it.

claim.description: What is wrong, one sentence, falsifiable. Not 'this looks fragile'.

caused_by.description: Required when the finding's line is outside the diff. Format 'path:HUNK_ID' (app/X.php:H1) or 'path:LINE' (app/X.php:142), pointing at a real added/removed line or hunk in the surface. An unresolvable value is rejected, not demoted.

scope.description: Set to 'pr-level' for findings about the whole change (no test for the new retry path, migration without rollback, description does not match the diff). No file/line needed.
